mapper.sql: SELECT c.company_id, c.company_code, c.company_name, c.trial_email AS email, c.trial_requested_at AS requested_at, c.email_verified_at, e.employee_name AS admin_name, e.employee_no AS admin_no FROM company c LEFT JOIN user_account a ON a.company_id = c.company_id AND a.role_code = 'ROLE_ADMIN' LEFT JOIN employee e ON e.company_id = a.company_id AND e.employee_id = a.employee_id
mapper.select: ORDER BY c.trial_requested_at DESC, c.company_id DESC

SELECT e.employee_name AS name, e.employee_no AS emp_no, d.department_name AS dept, a.status_code AS status, NVL(cc.code_name, a.status_code) AS status_label FROM user_account a JOIN employee e ON e.company_id = a.company_id AND e.employee_id = a.employee_id LEFT JOIN department d ON d.company_id = e.company_id AND d.department_id = e.department_id LEFT JOIN common_code cc ON cc.code = a.status_code WHERE a.company_id = #{companyId} ORDER BY e.employee_no

SELECT company_id, MIN(CASE WHEN status_code = 'PAY_APPROVED' THEN approved_at END) AS paid_at, COUNT(CASE WHEN status_code = 'PAY_FAILED' THEN 1 END) AS failed_payments FROM payment GROUP BY company_id
mapper.sql: SELECT public_inquiry_id AS no, TO_CHAR(created_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS') AS at, company_name AS company, requester_name AS name, email, phone, title, content AS body, status_code AS state FROM public_inquiry
mapper.select: ORDER BY created_at DESC, public_inquiry_id DESC
mapper.insert:
SELECT SQ_PUBLIC_REPLY.NEXTVAL FROM dual
INSERT INTO public_reply (public_reply_id, public_inquiry_id, operator_account_id, content) VALUES (#{replyId}, #{no}, #{operatorAccountId}, #{body, jdbcType=CLOB})
mapper.update: UPDATE public_inquiry SET status_code = 'IQ_ANSWERED', updated_at = CAST(SYSTIMESTAMP AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul' AS TIMESTAMP) WHERE public_inquiry_id = #{no} AND status_code IN ('IQ_RECEIVED', 'IQ_PROCESSING')
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM public_inquiry WHERE status_code = 'IQ_RECEIVED'
